test_cases.name: invalid-json-rejected
test_cases.command: cloudrobo infer create --name xyz --flavor f --model-json '{"model_id": "m", "model_version_id": "mv"}' --workspace-id {workspace_id} --pool-type SHARED --envs-json not-json
test_cases.description: Negative case — Verify malformed JSON is rejected; failure of the command is the PASS criterion
test_cases.expected: EXPECT-FAIL (exit != 0): Invalid value for '--envs-json': Invalid JSON for 'envs'

test_cases.name: path-traversal-rejected
test_cases.description: Negative case (evaluator TC-F-34 / TC-F-35) — Verify path traversal is rejected via validate_safe_id; failure of the command is the PASS criterion
test_cases.expected: EXPECT-FAIL (exit != 0): Invalid value for '--service-id': service_id format invalid (UUID pattern)

test_cases.name: missing-name-rejected
test_cases.description: Negative case — Verify the client-required --name is rejected by Click before any backend call; failure of the command is the PASS criterion

test_cases.name: missing-model-json-rejected
test_cases.command: cloudrobo infer create --name xyz --flavor f --pool-type SHARED --stop-schedule-json '{"duration": 60, "time_unit": "MINUTES"}'
test_cases.description: Negative case — Verify the client-required --model-json is rejected by Click before any backend call; failure of the command is the PASS criterion

test_cases.name: auto-discover-params
test_cases.command: cloudrobo asset show-asset --asset-id {model_id} → show-version → download-url → show-asset algorithm
test_cases.description: Auto-discover deployment parameters from algorithm asset and config files

variables.pool_id: Compute pool ID (optional; prefix with 'pool-', e.g. pool-d1cc6d45-...). Omit for SHARED pools — only pass for DEDICATED pools

notes: Cases with result=SKIP are mutating and require user confirmation before execution (never auto-run)
Cases with negative=true are EXPECT-FAIL: a non-zero exit code is the pass criterion; never execute them as positive functional cases
Deploy/start consume pool compute resources; wait-deploy (TC-09) polls every 5s, default 600s timeout
TC-12/TC-13 verify JSON validation and path traversal protection (negative cases, exit != 0 expected)
TC-14/TC-15 verify client-required options (--name / --model-json) are rejected by Click before any backend call (negative cases)
Cross-package tests query the asset service (list-publication-assets --type model or list-assets --catalog-id <id> --type model)
For comprehensive end-to-end testing beyond these read-only checks, run scripts/test-cli-commands.sh and the commands in SKILL.md manually
